en.headline: HKEX targets second half of 2028 for T+1 settlement
en.dek: The exchange published consultation conclusions showing broad support for shortening the cash-market cycle from T+2, while delaying the earlier proposed 2027 timeline after industry feedback.
body: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing said on Friday it aims to move the city’s cash equity market to a T+1 settlement cycle in the second half of 2028, subject to market readiness and regulatory approval.

The consultation conclusions, based on 109 responses from brokers, custodians, investment managers and other participants, confirmed widespread support for shortening the current T+2 cycle. Respondents cited benefits including lower settlement risk, better capital efficiency and alignment with major international markets. The US already uses T+1, and Europe plans to adopt it in 2027.

HKEX Chief Executive Bonnie Chan said the change would reinforce the attractiveness and connectivity of Hong Kong’s markets. The exchange will adopt a three-layer approach covering its own post-trade systems, workflow tools for participants, and industry-wide readiness. It had earlier floated a fourth-quarter 2027 target but postponed the timeline after participants asked for more preparation time.

zh.headline: 港交所目標2028年下半年過渡至T+1結算
zh.dek: 諮詢總結顯示市場廣泛支持將現貨市場結算周期由T+2縮短，但因業界要求更多準備時間，較早前提議的2027年時間表已推遲。
body: 香港交易所周五公布，擬在市場準備就緒並獲監管機構批准的前提下，於2028年下半年將香港股票現貨市場過渡至T+1結算周期。
是次諮詢共收到109份回應，來自經紀、託管商、投資經理等市場持份者，結果顯示廣泛支持由現時的T+2縮短結算周期。回應者認同此舉有助降低結算風險、提升資本效率，並與國際市場接軌。美國已採用T+1，歐洲計劃2027年實施。
港交所行政總裁陳翊庭表示，有關轉變有助鞏固香港市場的吸引力及全球聯通能力。港交所將透過三層方案推進，包括自身交收系統升級、為參與者開發工作流程工具，以及促進業界整體準備。港交所早前曾建議2027年第四季實施，但因市場要求更多準備時間而調整時間表。
